scope: Selected host certificate emission/integrity/replay operations; not all language requirements.

requirements.requirement: Signed implementation-grounded straight, constant and branching return certificates shall replay through both consumer commands; a false postcondition shall be rejected.
requirements.result_binding: Named outcome must be pass in the retained hosted baseline; independent adequacy review pending.

requirements.requirement: Strict replay shall authenticate the exact signed manifest enumeration and program label, rejecting missing/wrong signatures and deleted/reordered entries; legacy mode remains explicitly distinct.

requirements.requirement: The listed unsupported iteration-binding and empty-iteration cases shall not receive an invariant proof, preserving the tested runtime behavior.

requirements.requirement: Explicit replay shall enforce configured time and output limits, reject invalid configuration and accept a response within budget.

requirements.requirement: Requested replay shall reject missing solvers and empty obligation sets; hash-only verification shall remain available without a solver.

requirements.requirement: Replay shall accept exactly one clean UNSAT response from a successful process and reject conflicting, malformed, diagnostic and nonproof responses.

requirements.requirement: Strict source-root verification shall authenticate the exact parsed entry/import inventory and frozen source edges, accept identical relocated snapshots and reject substituted/missing/unsigned/malformed/duplicate/unreachable/traversing inputs; cache modes preserve the binding and legacy mode remains explicitly distinct.
requirements.result_binding: Named outcome must be pass in the retained hosted baseline; independent adequacy review pending.

requirements.requirement: Strict source-root verification shall check complete bounded transitive import selection/reachability, reject coherently omitted, duplicate/extra, absolute or missing graph inputs, support common-root relocation, avoid package/Git resolution and reject outside-root special files, cycles and excessive inventories.
requirements.result_binding: Named outcome must be pass in the retained hosted baseline; independent adequacy review pending.
